# 1 Clement Chapter 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 11 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_011_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 11

**11:1** Because of his hospitality and godliness Lot was saved out of Sodom, when all the surrounding region was condemned by fire and brimstone; the Sovereign Lord thereby making plain that he does not abandon those who set their hope in him, but delivers those who are differently minded to punishment and torment. [Gen 19]

**11:2** As a sign of this his wife was left behind; for since her soul was not in accord with his nor in agreement, she was turned into a pillar of salt to this day, that it might be known to all that those who are double-minded and entertain doubts about the power of God fall under judgment and become an example of warning to all generations. [Gen 19:26]

---

*LOGOS formal equivalence. "Differently minded" for *heterophronountas* — those whose thinking is oriented otherwise.*
